Vendored third-party sources

Only files the F3 build opens are kept. License texts: vendor/CMSIS_5/LICENSE.txt,
vendor/STM32F30x_StdPeriph_Driver/LICENSE.txt,
vendor/CMSIS_std/Device/ST/STM32F30x/LICENSE.txt, vendor/Package_license.md.

vendor/CMSIS_5/
  Source:  https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS_5 (tag 5.9.0)
  License: Apache-2.0
  Files are byte-identical to that tag.

vendor/STM32F30x_StdPeriph_Driver/ (driver V1.2.4, 15-December-2021)
vendor/CMSIS_std/Device/ST/STM32F30x/ (device headers V1.2.4)
  Source:  STM32F30x_DSP_StdPeriph_Lib V1.3.0 (STSW-STM32108, file
           stsw-stm32108_v1-3-0.zip)
           https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/stsw-stm32108.html
  License: terms in the LICENSE files ST ships with each directory, as the file
           headers say. Driver: SLA0044 Rev5 (February 2018). Device headers:
           BSD-3-Clause outside a package. Package terms: Package_license.md
           (SLA0048 Rev4, March 2018), copied from the package.
  Files are identical to that package (line endings converted to LF), with no
  local changes.

src/stm32/ (stm32f30x_conf.h, stm32f30x_it.c, stm32f30x_it.h, system_stm32f30x.c)
assembly/startup/startup_stm32f301x8.s
  Source:  ST StdPeriph template project V1.1.2 and ST startup file V2.2.0, changed
           for this project
  License: MCD-ST Liberty SW License Agreement V2 (Nov 16th, 2011), named in
           the file headers; text in src/stm32/ST_LICENSE.txt, copied from the
           agreement PDF in ST's STM32F30x_DSP_StdPeriph_Lib_V1.2.3 package.
